construction_method: Expert abstraction informed by a training-only audit of recurring operations in gold court reasoning and by general legal reasoning structure.
design_principle: Operators are domain-general executable reasoning methods, not summaries of individual doctrines or cases.
notes: The graph and operator prompts never receive court reasoning, judgment decisions, gold labels, reference issues, or reference states.
Issue-level supporting and opposing applications belong to executor outputs rather than operator records.
LEGIT inspired the rooted issue hierarchy and leaf-to-root resolution order; its gold conclusions are not used at inference time.
